C0988.title: Penalty Notice for Cheating via Plug-ins and Boosting in Game for Peace
C0988.summary: On November 8, 2024, the security operations team of Game for Peace issued a penalty notice, stating that accounts found installing or using unauthorized plug-ins, illegal add-ons, spectator-based wallhacks, or engaging in boosting services will face strict sanctions after verification by the Tencent Game Security Center.
